tasks.title: forge roadmap fill (safe pending repair)
tasks.objective: Add cmd_fill in roadmap.py (registered in forge.py): load the item by key; REFUSE if status != pending (never touch active/done); for each provided field (--story/--ac/--skill/--epic/--spec/--depends-on) set it ONLY if currently blank via _blank, and refuse to overwrite a non-blank field; record a roadmap-filled event. Reuse ITEM_SKILLS/check_item/resolve_spec_reference and missing_story_contract_fields to report what stays blank. A re-run is a safe no-op.
acceptance_criteria: forge roadmap fill sets ONLY currently-blank fields on a status==pending card and records the change (a roadmap-filled event).
It REFUSES an active card and a done card (never overwrites shipped history), naming why.
It refuses to overwrite a field that is already non-blank (blank-only); a re-run is a safe no-op.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "roadmap_fill"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The pending-only guard is the safety property: active AND done cards are refused, so history is never overwritten; blank-only (no clobber); the event is recorded; re-run is idempotent.

tasks.title: backfill provenance honesty (zero-match -> unresolved)
tasks.objective: In project.py backfill_project, the ZERO GitHub match branch no longer sets predates_outcome_contract; it reports the story as unresolved provenance (report+skip; the audit's board_problems keeps it red). Add a human-confirmed predates path: forge project mark-predates <key> --reason (records who/why + sets predates_outcome_contract) in project.py, registered in forge.py. Unique-match linking and 2+ ambiguous report+skip are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: forge project backfill on a ZERO GitHub match no longer sets predates_outcome_contract; it reports unresolved provenance and check_board_complete stays failing for that story.
forge project mark-predates <key> --reason is the human-confirmed way to set predates_outcome_contract (records the reason); backfill never sets it automatically.
A uniquely-recoverable PR still links and 2+ ambiguous still report+skip (unchanged).
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "project_backfill or mark_predates"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Honesty: backfill NEVER auto-sets predates on zero-match (stays red); predates is only human-confirmed via mark-predates; unique/ambiguous behaviour unchanged; no regression to the FORGE-BOARD-4 dogfood (all its stories matched uniquely).
